(a) containing a botanical extract of cannabis—
(i) with a concentration of not more than 30 milligrams of cannabidiol per millilitre,
and not more than 30 milligrams of delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol per millilitre, and
(ii) where the ratio of cannabidiol to delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol is between 0.7 and

(b) which is dispensed through a metered dose pump as a mucosal mouth spray, and
(c) which was approved for marketing by the Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory
Agency on 16th June 2010]
